evidence_kind: Static source review; R1 measurements below supplied by mission58 coordinator. No product execution by this reviewer.

r1.phase: omitted portfolio analysis; persistence completed, previousBinding read crossed the deadline before the independent binding read, selectionAgain and final analysis revalidation

comparison.bind.caveat: One call occurred at the deadline and lasted zero milliseconds.

comparison.read.caveat: Previous-binding observation was censored by timeout after 8116 ms.

limitations: Nested inclusive durations overlap and must not be added as CPU time.
Counts and timings identify repeated canonical/domain work but do not establish clone CPU as the dominant cost.
No later P03 phase was demonstrated; a completed component test suite does not qualify this journey.

findings: A54 already avoids the duplicated bind after canonical persistence; its initial previousBinding read, independent binding read and recovery branch remain distinct observations.
Reusing results across previousBinding, independent binding, selectionAgain, inspect/replay/inspect or case reads would remove or reorder required observations.

P03 has one candidate, no scenario assumptions and two criteria. The quadratic assumptions loop is empty and criterion/ref search loops are bounded small work; no evidence makes a rewrite causal for this timeout.
Repeated local hashes of cloned values might permit small pure common-subexpression savings, but no measured phase attributes a material share of the timeout to those expressions.

The owned code spends its expensive boundaries awaiting canonical ports. This review does not prove that all conceivable optimizations are impossible; it finds no justified owned change sufficient to warrant another run.

blocking_faults.mechanism: readSfState validates map shape, not cloneability of the complete graph after authorize.
blocking_faults.counterexample: authorize inserts a function into an unselected preferences field. The original structuredClone(state) throws and result-store returns unavailable; projected cloning can succeed and execute the second authorize callback.
blocking_faults.consequence: Result and callback count can change; frozen context does not certify state cloneability.

blocking_faults.mechanism: projectDecisionResult selects the case from stored.caseRef.id before cloning, while the original callback selects after cloning the full state.
blocking_faults.counterexample: An enumerable getter in stored, visited before caseRef, changes caseRef.id from A to B during cloning. The original clone includes cases A and B and then selects B; the projection has already restricted cases to A.
blocking_faults.consequence: Own-data descriptors for caseRef.id before cloning do not prove equivalent selected case.

blocking_faults.mechanism: Getters/proxies or clone failures in unselected state are omitted by projection.
blocking_faults.consequence: Effects before authority comparison and original case selection can differ. No proof covers the whole current state after the first authorize.

blocking_faults.mechanism: Changing !value to !value?.stored adds a distinct malformed response behavior.
blocking_faults.counterexample: An opaque state adapter returning value:{} previously causes a rejected access to value.stored.kind; the proposal instead returns unavailable.
blocking_faults.consequence: The proposal is not strictly behavior-preserving for the opaque adapter path.

external_projection_review.release_condition: Owner must supply a causally measured correction with a proven current-observation data contract or equivalent fallback, then A45 checks and original P03 on an exact 57 composition. The present patch is a rejected/held hypothesis, not a recommended fix.

external_anchor_review.proposal: Change readPortfolioSnapshot root surface from dashboard to procurement
narrow_support: Raw LocalStore56 always takes the global write lock and observes all three SQL surfaces in the same order.
The helper ignores root target and blob arguments, commits false and retains Request/scope fences.
Nested writes poison the root and currentSnapshots returns independent graphs.
Changing the anchor could make Dashboard eligible for the non-target materialization path, but no actual speedup was measured.
external_anchor_review.blocking_fault: The installed source-lifecycle wrapper runs requireSourceIdentities(snapshot) and initializes guard(surface,snapshot) before work, including commit:false. Changing the root surface changes the metadata/audit prerequisites and can change behavior for partial or corrupt source metadata. The generic Persistence contract also does not promise interchangeable surfaces.
external_anchor_review.conclusion: Raw-fixture equivalence is insufficient to qualify the installed product; do not use a fixture-specific anchor change as proof of a general correction.

action.next_owner: 57 remains sole integrator; A45 owns checks.
action.retry_rule: Do not repeat P03 on unchanged inputs or on an unqualified speculative patch. Require an actual causal owner correction with exact inputs and suitable gates.
